name: token-shield
description: Prompt-cache awareness for long Claude Code sessions: trustworthy cache state, priced levers, and guards before expensive rebuilds.

thresholdUsd.title: Rebuild threshold (dollars)
thresholdUsd.description: Hold or warn before a prompt whose cache rebuild costs more than this many API-equivalent dollars. Ignored on a subscription, where only the token threshold applies.

thresholdTokens.title: Rebuild threshold (tokens)
thresholdTokens.description: Hold or warn before a prompt that re-caches more than this many tokens.

warnWindow1h.title: Expiry warning (1-hour cache)
warnWindow1h.description: How long before a 1-hour cache expires to warn, such as 10m.

warnWindow5m.title: Expiry warning (5-minute cache)
warnWindow5m.description: How long before a 5-minute cache expires to warn, such as 1m.

gate.title: Submit gate
gate.description: hold: hold an expensive prompt until you send it again. warn: show a warning instead. off: neither.

switchConfirm.title: Confirm costly model switches
switchConfirm.description: on: put the rebuild cost inside Claude Code's confirmation before a warm model switch over the threshold.

mutedLevels.title: Muted notification levels
mutedLevels.description: Comma-separated levels to silence: info, warning, critical.

glyphs.title: Glyphs
glyphs.description: unicode, or ascii for terminals that can't draw the symbols.

keepAliveDefaultBudgetUsd.title: Keep-alive budget (dollars)
keepAliveDefaultBudgetUsd.description: The budget a keep-alive starts with unless you give one.

keepAliveDefaultMinutes.title: Keep-alive length (minutes)
keepAliveDefaultMinutes.description: How long a keep-alive runs unless you give an end time.

historyDays.title: History kept (days)
historyDays.description: Days of cache history kept for calibration and the history views.

priceOverridesPath.title: Price overrides file
priceOverridesPath.description: A JSON file of your own prices, merged over the bundled table. Empty for <data>/prices.override.json.
